leads.name: Lutherlinde
leads.reason: Wikidata Q58015520 lead, and matches LUBW register id 83110000045 (RIPS 3119013000138, designated 1974-05-02) almost exactly via the de.wikipedia Naturdenkmal list join. Register + Wikidata corroborate existence and coordinates, but no second source with actual descriptive facts (age, story, why 'Luther') was found this pass; WebSearch turned up nothing specific to this tree despite several tries. Also about 3.4 km west of the Altstadt centre, outside the walkable cluster. Worth a targeted search next time for 'Lutherlinde Freiburg' combined with the street/neighbourhood once known, or a direct look at the RIPS steckbrief page (rips-dienste.lubw.baden-wuerttemberg.de, id=3119013000138), which loaded fine for other trees this pass but was not checked for this one due to time.

leads.name: Bergahorn, Ecke Hildastraße/Urachstraße
leads.reason: Well documented: planted around 1940, 13 m crown, girth over 2 m, was 'Baum des Jahres' locally, designated Naturdenkmal 2011-01-28 (register id 83110000135, RIPS 3119013000225; Freiburg Amtsblatt article + badische-zeitung 'Nasenzwickerle unter Denkmalschutz', 2009, as sources). BLOCKED ON ACCESS, not evidence: freiburg-schwarzwald.de states plainly it stands 'auf dem Grundstück des Erzbischöflichen Ordinariats in der Hildastraße 65, dem jetzigen Bürogebäude des Erzbischöflichen Bauamtes' (on the grounds of the Archbishopric's own office building), opposite the old Wiehre train station. That reads as institutional/private office grounds rather than a plainly public street tree, and no source confirms public access. Worth checking with an OSM access-tag query (per the Ypres technique in BRIEF_RESEARCH.md) or a street-view look before a future pass ships it.

leads.name: 1 Kaukasische Flügelnuss
leads.reason: Still only a register entry (id 83110000161, RIPS steckbrief 3119013000252, designated 2021-10-29; RIPS itself carries no description). Confirmed 2026-09-03 pass: reverse-geocodes to Dreisamuferweg, Mittelwiehre (a path along the Dreisam river). Targeted searches for the Amtsblatt vom 5.11.2021 announcement and for 'Freiburg 30 neue Naturdenkmale 2021' (freiburg.de/pb/1829585.html, the city's own press release on that batch of 30) found only generic species lists, no tree-specific description. Still needs a second source; the Amtsblatt PDF itself (freiburg.de/pb/site/Freiburg/get/documents_E-1847784871/freiburg/daten/news/amtsblatt/pdf/SS711_Naturdenkmale.pdf) was found in search results but not fetched this pass, worth trying directly next time.

leads.name: 1 Mammutbaum, Schubertstraße / Franz-Liszt-Straße
leads.reason: Register entry only (id 83110000129, RIPS 3119013000219, designated 2011-01-28), ~2 km north of centre. Searched 2026-09-03: no second source found; distinct from the well-documented Mammutbaum an der Starkenstraße (now published as frb_005, a different tree/different register id/different designation year, 1979 not 2011). Do not confuse the two on a future pass.

leads.name: 1 Tulpenbaum, Kartäuserstraße
leads.reason: Register entry only (id 83110000132, RIPS 3119013000222, designated 2011-01-28), ~1.7 km east of centre, on the same street as the now-published Kartaus Plane (frb_007) but a different spot further along Kartäuserstraße. Not searched this pass for a second source; follow-up candidate.

leads.name: Bergahorn auf dem Kybfelsen
leads.reason: freiburg-schwarzwald.de: called the most 'urwüchsig' (primeval-looking) Naturdenkmal, about 220 years old, on the Kybfelsen (a rock outcrop, possibly near the Kyburg viewpoint on the route to Waldtraut vom Mühlwald in Günterstal, unconfirmed). Not matched to a register coordinate this pass.

leads.name: Herdermer Eichhalde oak stand
leads.reason: freiburg-schwarzwald.de: a stand of oaks that gave the street 'Eichhalde' its name in the Herdern district, designated as a group Naturdenkmal in 2006 after local advocacy (a 'Bürgerinitiative Zähringer Eiche' page also references a 350-year-old oak felled nearby, worth disentangling from this one). Not matched to a register coordinate this pass; also reads as more of a stand than a single collectible point, so may not pass the ensemble test even if pinned down.

leads.name: 2 Mammutbäume, 1 Lebensbaum, 1 Douglasie, 1 Zeder (conifer group)
leads.reason: Register group entry (id 83110000116, RIPS 3119013000203, designated 1998-03-24). A WebSearch AI summary claimed this group stands inside the Alter Friedhof cemetery, but the coordinates are about 3 km from the Alter Friedhof's own FND coordinates (48.0009867, 7.8575983), so that claim does not survive checking and was DISCARDED (the exact 'search summary is a lead, never a source' trap named in BRIEF_RESEARCH.md). Real location and setting unconfirmed; needs its own search before use.
